notes.title: Limited event “Cosplay” is underway!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/5997988fe2deec759ae44e95400e18ff824d77db.png[/img]
The limited-time event map “[b]Cosplay[/b]” is now available.

Entering the event map requires 1,500 Energy(♥).
Clicking on the event map requires 3 Energy(♥).

The items and photos you can get from the event map are as follows.

Caliburn (1/450)
Welsh onion root (1/4,000)
Gohei (1/10,000)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/5c50c06b4e20878f27bc380328d11d7112912f3a.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/fe54ab49b52997a1a8161e8d4809486a065b0aac.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/5e57ec5e826ba3ddb2d5db69f3982ad115859b37.png[/img]

Caliburn → Knight Cosplay Photo
Welsh onion root → Vocal Cosplay Photo
Gohei → Miko Cosplay Photo

The event will run for 14 days until June 8th.

Additionally, The 4th extra event “[b]Cosplay Contest[/b]” will be held during the same period.

[h3]Event Description:[/h3]
During the event period, you will earn scores by obtaining the following event photos.
[list]
[*]Knight Cosplay Photo : +30
[*]Vocal Cosplay Photo : +200
[*]Miko Cosplay Photo : +500
[/list](If you get photos for half price or free through a photo boost, they will still count towards your score normally.)

The top 10 players with the highest scores at the end of the event will be rewarded according to their ranking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/c93441c36de27eca3f9be2e0352a667b732085f3.png[/img]
You can check score ranking and 'my score' by clicking the trophy icon within the game. The score ranking is updated at regular intervals.

[h3]Ranking Reward:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/d60c1380a5dc4814511ffc677522b04265464531.png[/img]
[i](Idol Cosplay Photo)[/i]

1st place - [b]Idol Cosplay Photo[/b] + 2,000 Gems
2nd place - [b]Idol Cosplay Photo[/b] + 1,500 Gems
3rd place - [b]Idol Cosplay Photo[/b] + 1,000 Gems
4th place - [b]Idol Cosplay Photo[/b] + 700 Gems
5th place - [b]Idol Cosplay Photo[/b] + 500 Gems
6th place - [b]Idol Cosplay Photo[/b] + 400 Gems
7th place - [b]Idol Cosplay Photo[/b] + 300 Gems
8th place - [b]Idol Cosplay Photo[/b] + 200 Gems
9th place - [b]Idol Cosplay Photo[/b] + 150 Gems
10th place - [b]Idol Cosplay Photo[/b] + 100 Gems

Also, the winners will be announced through the community after the event ends.

At the same time, the previous event "[b]Office[/b]" is being rerun, so be sure to check that out too!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3004950/view/538854612737721501

Have fun with Naomi!

notes.title: 1.2.2 Patch Note
notes.content:
- Reduced the delay time of all item acquisition notification messages from 120 frames to 60 frames. Now you can continue to perform tasks faster when opening gashapon, as well as after obtaining items by clicking.

- Now displays the number of runs remaining when using gashapon.

- Conduct a gameplay survey.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/f6819bb94c90314c5285163a56edfb085106dee6.png[/img]
You can participate in the survey by clicking on the in-game icon.
If you complete the survey, you will immediately receive 100 Gems. (You can participate only once, and it will be available for approximately 3 days.)

- Added a loading image when communicating with the ranking server.

notes.title: 1.2.1 Patch Note
notes.content:
- Now you don't have to open your inventory every time you want to use a Gashapon! Just input the number of times you want and the Gashapon will be used automatically for that number of times.

- Maximum energy(♥) limit expanded from 99,999,999 to 999,999,999.

- Fixed an issue where moving from an event map to another map would no longer allow you to enter the event map.

- Fixed an error where the extra event 'My Score' was displayed as 0.

- Some missing translations have been applied.
